synthesizedFacts.fact: Niacinamide, also known as nicotinamide, is a form of Vitamin B3 that is essential for various cellular functions.
Niacinamide is beneficial for the skin as it helps regulate sebum production, strengthens the skin barrier, and reduces inflammation.
Niacinamide has antioxidant properties that protect the skin from environmental stressors and can help reduce signs of aging.
Niacinamide is water-soluble and does not cause skin flushing, unlike other forms of Vitamin B3.
Niacinamide can be found naturally in foods such as vegetables, cereals, eggs, milk, fish, and meats.
